description: A Minecraft addon that lets you enter coordinates and get a heading on your locator bar

mods.name: Heading Marker
mods.description: Waypoint management mod. Works server-side OR client-side (singleplayer). Optional on clients when connecting to servers with the mod installed.

releases.notes:
Release of Heading Marker mod v1.3.0

**Installation:**
1. Download the JAR file
2. Place it in your Minecraft `mods` folder
3. Make sure you have Fabric Loader, Fabric API, and Fabric Language Kotlin installed
4. Launch Minecraft 26.3

**Requirements:**
- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+
- Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3
- Fabric Language Kotlin 1.14.1+
- Java 25
